The '''Bleeder Spice Flow''' was the name given to an industrial section of the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The area was used by the [[Bleeder]] gangs to process and distribute their [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bleeder Spice Flow appears as part of the Red Light Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
